name: F6_complex_multientity
sw_rationale: Family 6 (Complex multi-entity). A bracket-like profile: 2 horizontal lines, 2 vertical lines, 1 diagonal, 2 arcs (fillet at a corner, large arc for a boss), 1 circle (bolt hole). All chained with coincidents, h/v, tangent, concentric, radius, distance dims. Should solve to dof=0 with all entities 'full'. This is the 'it should just work' test for a realistic SW sketch. Geometry: bottom line (0,0)-(100,0), right vertical (100,0)-(100,60), top horizontal (100,60)-(0,60), left vertical (0,60)-(0,0). Plus a fillet arc at bottom-right corner r=10 (tangent to bottom line and right vertical), a circle centered at (50,30) r=12 (bolt hole). Total ~10 entities, fully constrained. Confidence HIGH for dof=0 if all coincidents/tangents are correct.

expect._coord_notes: Rectangle 100x60 with fillet arc r=10 at bottom-right. e2 arc center at (90,10), tangent to e1 (horizontal) and e3 (vertical). Circle bolt-hole at (50,30) r=12. All entities fully defined. This is the 'should just work' complex sketch.
